kicker.zh: 型号 / 接口 / 材料

intro.en: Find a cable model or material part number, then send it for a custom replacement or original-part sourcing review.
intro.zh: 按成品型号或材料料号查找，提交编号即可沟通兼容替代件制作或原厂件采购。

search_label.en: Find a model or part number

search_placeholder.en: Brand, model, part number or product type
search_placeholder.zh: 输入品牌、型号、料号或产品类型

empty.en: No matching references. Try a brand, full part number or a listed alias.
empty.zh: 未找到匹配项，请尝试品牌、完整料号或已列出的别名。

intro.en: Finished interface references for this application direction. Installation and acceptance requirements are reviewed per project.
intro.zh: 本应用方向的成品接口选型参考，具体使用位置与验收条件按项目确认。

intro.en: Connector, wire and process-material references for project selection.
intro.zh: 供项目选型的连接器、线材与工艺材料参考。

copy.en: Identify the governing drawing, military specification and revision for the required project assembly.
copy.zh: 明确项目组件依据的图纸、军用规范及版本。

copy.en: Confirm qualification and source documentation for each controlled purchased component.
copy.zh: 确认每项受控采购组件的鉴定状态及来源文件。

copy.en: Define insert arrangement, keying, shielding and each power, signal or RF path.
copy.zh: 定义插芯排列、防呆、屏蔽及各电源、信号或射频通路。

copy.en: Agree finish, wire specification, traceability and any restricted substitutions.
copy.zh: 约定表面处理、线材规范、追溯及限制替代的材料。

copy.en: Set the required environmental and mechanical tests for the actual project configuration.
copy.zh: 按实际项目配置确定所需环境与机械测试。

copy.en: Specify inspection and test records; catalog references do not establish Super Smile military qualification.
copy.zh: 明确检验与测试记录；目录型号不代表超斯迈尔具有军用鉴定资格。

boundary.en: Send the part number, drawing or sample to confirm the replacement configuration and sourcing plan.
boundary.zh: 请提供型号、图纸或样品，具体替代配置与原厂件采购方案按项目确认。

text.en: Send the model or part number to discuss your project.
text.zh: 提交型号或料号，沟通您的定制与采购需求。
